_comment: Capability-root manifest for gateway/ (ADR-0562). Every crate, capability file path, contract path, OpenSLO path and accounting count below was read off the gateway/ tree at authoring time. microservices/api-gateway dump-path cites are retargeted only when the destination exists under gateway/; missing historical IP assets keep their legacy cite in REORG-DRAIN rather than inventing files.

substrate_dag_position._note: specs/capability-registry.json name=gateway dag_node=api-gateway stratum=S0; depends_on/consumed_by currently empty on registry entry. Prior substrate_dependencies facet (identity/policy-engine/…) retained only as narrative in purpose — not invented as DAG edges.

purpose: Dedicated Tier-0 north-south edge for tenant, partner, mobile, browser traffic. Owns TLS 1.3 + ECH + PQC termination, HTTP/3 fallback chain, anti-bot/anti-spoof/anti-scrape defence-in-depth, per-tenant rate-limiting, Cedar-gated route admission, authentication handoff, mTLS-SPIFFE to upstream, blue/green + canary, circuit-breaking.

bounded_contexts.name: gateway-adapters
bounded_contexts.description: Connector adapters under gateway/adapters/ (third-party SaaS connector command-shaping libraries; no live connector runtime claimed by this root slice).

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: Ten connector adapter crates under gateway/adapters/ are owned by this capability root. gateway/connector carries its own sub-manifest (registry absorb list) and is listed as absorbed. No core/ports/facade crates exist under gateway/ yet for the north-south edge kernel — edge capabilities are YAML capability declarations + OpenSLO only until those crates land.
